import re

def test_regex_filtering():
    tags = "tag1,tag2"
    tag_list = [tag.strip() for tag in tags.split(',') if tag.strip()]
    regex_pattern = r'(' + '|'.join(re.escape(tag) for tag in tag_list) + ')'
    assert regex_pattern == r'(tag1|tag2)', f"Unexpected regex pattern: {regex_pattern}"
